system.description:
Attack Action, Doom +2 every use. Roll a Skill Die. Grit: all enemies within Near Range (15 ft) are knocked Prone and take 3 Blunt. Wit: shadow tendrils Grapple an enemy of your choice, and its checks to break free are opposed by your Strange instead of Grit. Smarts: Opposed Strange vs an enemy's Smarts; on a win it is Immobile and Weakened until your next Combat Turn. Heart: Opposed Strange vs an enemy's Heart; on a win it must obey one command that won't harm itself (1 Combat Round in combat). Strange: the ritual backfires; everyone within Long Range (150 ft), you included, passes a CR 2 Strange Check or takes 3 Soul, and Doom +1 per enemy damaged. Luck: choose the effect.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.66
